from brain.alphas import alpha
import numpy as np
import numpy.typing as npt


@alpha(
    data=["cfg2_top1200_residual_return"],
    store=[],
)
def resid_snr(data, store) -> npt.NDArray[np.float32]:
    x = data.cfg2_top1200_residual_return
    m = np.nanmean(x[-120:], axis=0)
    sd = np.nanstd(x[-120:], axis=0)
    sig = -(m / (sd + 1e-6))
    sig[~data.universe[-1].astype(bool)] = np.nan
    sig = np.clip(sig, -3.0, 3.0)
    return sig.astype(np.float32)

from brain.alphas import alpha
import numpy as np
import numpy.typing as npt


@alpha(
    data=["cfg2_top1200_residual_return"],
    store=[],
)
def resid_disp(data, store) -> npt.NDArray[np.float32]:
    x = data.cfg2_top1200_residual_return
    m = np.nanmean(x[-120:], axis=0)
    disp_recent = np.nanstd(x[-20:], axis=0)
    disp_long = np.nanstd(x[-250:], axis=0)
    ratio = disp_recent / (disp_long + 1e-9)
    scale = np.nanmedian(ratio)
    sig = -m * np.clip(scale, 0.0, 3.0)
    sig[~data.universe[-1].astype(bool)] = np.nan
    sig = np.clip(sig, -3.0, 3.0)
    return sig.astype(np.float32)
